entries.title: Havendock
entries.definitive_edition: Havendock - Full Complete Set on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Havendock - Full Complete Set with Wizard Island DLC
primary.why: Havendock reached 1.0 on April 22, 2025 and supports Windows, macOS, and Linux/SteamOS on Steam. There is also a Wizard Island DLC and a Full Complete Set bundle including the base game plus DLC. Windows PC with Wizard Island installed is the best archive route for complete current content, settings, and capture.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC release with the Wizard Island DLC installed. Use macOS or Linux only as native convenience alternatives.

entries.remaster_caveats: Wizard Island is DLC, not a separate game or remaster; include it for the most complete current route.
